title: BLUEmed: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Debate for Clinical Error Detection
authors: Saukun Thika You; Nguyen Anh Khoa Tran; Wesley K. Marizane; Hanshu Rao; Qiunan Zhang; Xiaolei Huang
